reason: The plan covers assessment, provisioning, replication, rehearsal, communication, mandatory pre-cutover backup, cutover, integrity verification, rollback, and post-migration wrap-up within exactly 12 numbered steps, satisfying every hard requirement including backup-before-destructive-step ordering. It is a coherent, actionable runbook, though it doesn't quantify replication lag thresholds or address logical replication limitations (e.g., DDL, sequences) that a 2TB migration would realistically hit.
